verdict.rationale: Box documents an enterprise event feed that lets an application subscribe to actions by any user or service in an enterprise, with both real-time monitoring and historical record queries through the authenticated API. That is first-party API access to team activity logs. The evidence is thin on audit-log specifics, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented audit event types, retention period, and required admin scopes; any documented SIEM export or connector; independent or hands-on corroboration that the enterprise event stream works for auditing.

support.subject: As a security engineer, activity is auditable — team event/audit logs with documented API access or SIEM export

citations.quote: The event feed provides a way for an application to subscribe to any actions performed by any user, users, or service in an enterprise.
Subscribe to user or enterprise events in Box, compare stream types, and monitor actions in real time or query historical records.
API requests use the base URL `https://api.box.com/2.0` and require an OAuth 2.0 access token
